purpose: Owner-fixed Qwen K20 Test evaluation; no selection on Test results
cache_policy: fresh; no historical or cross-job caches
failure_policy: Exactly one HTTP request per unique input; no retries or schema fallback; unavailable rows retained. Each L1/L2 job invoked once.

evaluation.unavailable: Retain denominators; L1 unavailable is not correct; L2 whole-query fusion fallback

constraints: English NevIR fixed Test candidates; no recall, training, prompt or label changes
Exactly the declared L1 and K20 L2 jobs; no K/trigger/model selection on Test
Fresh independent jobs; one request per unique input within each job, no retries
Member Test results retained separately; never overwrite the Issue #23 folder
Only aggregate results are displayed; raw Test rows remain local experiment artifacts
model_choice_basis: Owner-fixed Qwen14B thinking K20; historical development selection already documented before original confirmation. This repetition does not reselect the main model.

engineering_smoke.scope: Three synthetic query/passage inputs outside NevIR; schema and transport check only; never reused as evaluation scores

test_exposure: Issue #23 member E0/fusion/N8 aggregates already observed; no Qwen Test outputs yet

population.primary: official label available, both designated passages covered, no structural conflict
population.sensitivity: Also report all 2738 covered queries including the structural-conflict pair
population.cross_split_duplicate_passages: 4 exact shared passages retained; no deletion

statistics.primary_contrast: Qwen stage1_judge minus fixed fusion stage1
statistics.sign_test: directional exact test; no group or multiplicity correction

version_control_status: Pre-inference record; exact committed bytes required before launch; actual execution HEAD recorded in worker-start.json

storage.scope: This task across its isolated runtime and data directories; existing unrelated data retained
storage.policy: One GPU model at a time; remote driver and about 58 MB of fixed inputs; reserve 4 GB for request artifacts and caches; retrieve outputs before removing only task-owned Qwen model/cache for BGE

infrastructure_migration.authorization: Owner supplied replacement SSH connection and requested a 35 GB storage budget
infrastructure_migration.research_configuration: Model revision, prompt, K20, scores, population, decoding and failure policy unchanged
infrastructure_migration.runtime_note: Pinned GPU runtime on Python 3.13.5, with the project driver in a separate Python 3.13.5 environment; dependency lists recorded separately. Initial Python 3.10.8 service initialization failed in Triton source inspection before any model requests; a standalone source-inspection reproduction passed on 3.13.5. No vLLM or Triton source patches.

execution.source: Deploy committed source and exact frozen config before launch; prepared input rows unchanged
execution.outputs: Remote run directory; retrieve to the local run directory after completion
execution.control: Local workflow qwen checks committed config, remote config bytes and exclusive launch/worker markers; no auto restart

code_commit_scope: Preparation base revision; actual execution revision is recorded separately at job launch
